messages:
rachel: Quick FYI - spotted an oddity in the Kotlin SDK suspend helper when using large multipart uploads + auth refresh. Java callback sample retries fine; suspend path fails with a write error and doesn't retry.

Tom: Can you share OkHttp/Retrofit versions + device?

rachel: Retrofit 2.9, OkHttp 4.10.0, Kotlin 1.8, repro on Pixel 7 emulator (API 34) and real Pixel 4 (API 30). Error: `java.io.IOException: sink closed` during RequestBody.writeTo after a 401 from our auth test proxy.

vikram: That sounds like a non-repeatable body + Call reuse. If the suspend helper holds the original Call across the auth flow, the second attempt will hit an exhausted stream. Java path probably clones the Call or reconstructs the body.

sasha: Did you try wrapping the body to buffer it? Quick hack: create a buffered RequestBody that writes into a Buffer once and replays on each writeTo. Not great memory-wise but validates the hypothesis.

rachel: Tried buffering local small files, that made the retry succeed. Large files OOM on device, so not ideal. Stack snippet: `okio.ForwardingSink.write -> java.io.IOException: sink closed` followed by `okhttp3.internal.http2.StreamAllocation.streamFailed`.

Tom: Two action items: 1) make the suspend adapter clone the Call for each execution (`val attempt = original.clone()`), 2) detect one-shot RequestBody and log a clear warning (link to docs) so sample apps get actionable guidance. Also add an instrumented test that simulates mid-stream 401.

vikram: I'll prototype a small `RepeatableRequestBody` util in the SDK that uses temp file backing for big bodies (stream to file then replay) to avoid OOM for big uploads. We'll document the perf tradeoffs.

sasha: Filed RN ticket DEVX-1129 with repro gist and device traces. Pushing a tiny PR that clones the Call in suspend adapter + a warning log. CI runs flaky on API 34 emulators so adding retries to the test.

ci-bot: ci: PR #3781 - unit tests passed :white_check_mark: instrumented upload test failed on API 34 emulator :hourglass_flowing_sand:.

rachel: Thanks all. For short-term, adding note to onboarding sample app: "avoid streaming large multipart uploads with suspend helper until SDK ships temp-file-backed repeatable body or use Java callback path" :thumbsup:

Tom: Sounds good. Assigning @vikram to follow up on temp-file backing and @sasha on tests.
